description: Defines the HttpStreamRequest class and its nested Delegate and Helper classes, which manage HTTP stream creation requests, including callback mechanisms for success, failure, proxy auth, SSL client auth, and protocol negotiation details.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest
classes.description: Represents a client's handle to an HTTP stream creation request, managing callbacks and request state.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to handle success, failure, proxy auth, SSL auth, and QUIC status during stream creation.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest::Helper
classes.description: Interface providing load state, request completion, proxy auth restart, and priority setting functionalities.

methods.name: HttpStreamRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing a stream request with URL, helper, delegate, WebSocket helper, log, and stream type.

methods.name: RestartTunnelWithProxyAuth
methods.description: Resumes stream creation after proxy authentication credentials are collected.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of the request.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the request as complete with negotiation details.

methods.name: AddConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Records connection attempts made during the request.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the request.

methods.name: negotiated_protocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol negotiated with the server.

methods.name: alternate_protocol_usage
methods.description: Returns the reason for using a specific transport protocol.

methods.name: using_spdy
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is using SPDY.

methods.name: connection_attempts
methods.description: Returns the connection attempts made for the request.

methods.name: websocket_handshake_stream_create_helper
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket handshake stream create helper.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the request.

methods.name: stream_type
methods.description: Returns the type of stream requested.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Indicates if the request has been completed.
